scope: SDevice-only n23 HFS-off OldSlotboom versus explicit NoBandGapNarrowing by SRH(DopingDependence) 2x2 causal ablation

manual_contract.default_behavior: Bandgap narrowing is active unless explicitly disabled.

fixed_invariants.bias_route: equilibrium then drain ramp then DoZero gate ramp

claim_policy: The solver log, not the deck label, is authoritative for the effective BGN model.
A no-BGN cell is accepted only when NoBandGapNarrowing is explicit and both log and exported field confirm it.
Donor and acceptor observability is mandatory; missing fields fail the run instead of being treated as zero.
Only BGN and SRH are varied; HFS remains disabled in all four cells.
